expectedBehavior: one enabled empty GroupWorkspace can be explicitly initialized exactly once with independently entered group code and name
duplicate/concurrent initialization never creates a second root and has a stable readback recovery
operations-admin proves only an independent session, not an invented business page

findings.title: Exact implementation version line remains intentionally undecided
findings.evidence: R3 authorization forbids compile/download/version spike; design §8 assigns the decision to future GATE_0.
findings.risk: A later implementation could silently choose incompatible versions if it skips its designated decision.
findings.disposition: retain as a bounded GATE_0 decision; do not run an unauthorized spike now

findings.title: J02 Heritage source is source-reopened but not yet an R3-native frozen registry asset
findings.evidence: selection decision records the exact all-v2 D01-S05 and commercial-group-root paths; the current Heritage registry freezes only the R1 denominator.
findings.risk: A future source edit could make ad-hoc rereads less reproducible.
findings.disposition: Claude must assess whether a minimal hash receipt is sufficient before implementation; do not copy or mutate Heritage under this design-only cycle

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The design realizes Dexter's accepted initialization task, not an interface-led lookup or generic administration surface.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Lookup-only, create-time implicit initialization and an operations organization page were compared and rejected because they do not satisfy the task or enlarge scope.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Four owner modules and nine operations are the smallest topology that preserves separate identities, GroupWorkspace ownership and CommercialGroup ownership without false facts.

conclusion.summary: J02 is a source-backed, bounded platform task and is ready for fresh independent review; N findings are not implementation permissions.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: R3-J02 remains design-only. No GATE_0 execution, business implementation, dynamic run, database action, seed/reset or Git write is authorized.
